messages.text: Hello everyone I would like to thank you for the delivery of my 30th model.

That's great to hear, Rob. The B30 is the strongest box in your fleet now, so give it a day to settle and it should sit right around its rated hashrate.

Anything you want me to check on the rest of your orders while you're here?

And if you were happy with how we handled things, a quick word on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

Hello I need help setting up my kbox. My name is Robin L.. I purchased the Kbox. I knew how to set up a miner. This thing thinks it is overheating and it is not but I have no access to heating control? Can you please help.
